run_aslg_pc12_main: run the ASLG_PC12 dataset preprocessing script to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_aslg_pc12_dataset: create an ASLG_PC12 dataset object to load and preprocess the ASLG PC12 sign language dataset
load_aslg_pc12_hf_dataset: load the aslg_pc12 HuggingFace dataset using the load_dataset method of ASLG_PC12
split_aslg_pc12_train_test: split the ASLG PC12 training data into 80 percent train and 20 percent test sets
map_aslg_pc12_to_list: map the HuggingFace ASLG PC12 dataset to a list of text and gloss tuple pairs
